operation_details.item: The user uses Procreate for sketching concepts.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the creative work going today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty well. I’m sketching out a few concepts for the new client project.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice. Are you starting with rough digital sketches or jumping straight into layouts?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I usually start in Procreate for sketching concepts, then refine the strongest direction.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: And do you move the refined work into Illustrator or Figma afterward?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes. I use Illustrator for vector work and Figma for UI design, depending on the deliverable.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds like a good workflow. How are you keeping the concept iterations organized?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I keep all the concept files in a shared cloud folder so the team can review the progression.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that I use Procreate for sketching, while keeping the other tools and the shared folder.
